summary: Swap in a new photo and describe it for people who can't see it.
content:
1. In the sidebar on the far left, select the **Collections** icon, then **Menu**.
2. Select the dish to open it.
3. Scroll down to **Photo** and move your pointer over the picture. A row of small buttons appears.
4. Select **Upload New Image** and choose your photo.
5. When the upload finishes, select **Edit Image Info** from the same row of buttons.
6. In **Alt Text**, describe the photo in one short sentence, such as "A bowl of pappardelle with chanterelles".
7. Scroll to the bottom and select **Save**.

Alt text is read aloud to guests who use a screen reader, and it helps search engines understand the photo.

## Before you upload

- A landscape photo works best.
- You don't need to resize anything. The website makes the right size for every screen.
- Need a better shot? Read [Take better food photos](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/take-better-food-photos).
title: Change a dish's photo
